prelaunch_correction: Before any payload/CUDA access: nearest-FP16 RMS was superseded by a post-FP32-cast validated upward FP16 loop; represented channel gain is rounded downward and noise sigma upward; source reads authenticate and decode one descriptor buffer; counter randomness, sealed resume, runtime binding, and fail-closed finite checks were added.
claim_boundary: A negative result rejects only this preregistered SILWARP training cell. A positive result is an information-valid ideal-channel auxiliary survivor, not a finite codec and not permission to open the pinned panel.

source_authentication.gate_hash_access_disclosure: The two L3/E57 and L3/E121 Gate confirmation files were full-file hashed by root for pretraining authentication only; numeric values remain undecoded/unscored until promotion.
source_authentication.file_policy: regular non-symlink files only; exact basename, size, split, and SHA-256; one os.open descriptor with O_NOFOLLOW where available is fstat-checked, read, hashed, and decoded from that same buffer
source_authentication.access_order: authenticate fit/calibration before numeric decode; do not hash or decode confirmation in the runner until calibration promotion

source.source_derived_metadata: one nearest-even FP16 mean and one post-cast-validated upward FP16 RMS per role; RMS is computed in FP64 about the serialized mean; no per-tile source feature
source.moment_algorithm: mean16=nearest-even FP16(exact FP64 mean); rms64=sqrt(mean_FP64((x-float(mean16))^2)); start at smallest positive finite FP16 >= rms64 (exact zero uses minimum positive subnormal); form X32=Q32((x-float(mean16))/float(rms16)), re-evaluate mean_FP64(X32^2), and advance rms16 by FP16 ULPs until this actual post-cast moment is <=1; NaN/infinity/overflow fail closed
source.normalization_invariant: for the actual decoder input X32, mean_FP64(X32^2)<=1 exactly; both learned and identity scores use this exact serialized path

split.disjointness: No layer and no expert identity is shared by fit, calibration, or confirmation.

information_channel.map: Conceptual Y*=a32*X32+sigma32*Z with Z iid N(0,1), followed by Y32=Q32(Y*); a32 is rounded downward and sigma32 upward from the design channel.
information_channel.proof: Post-cast RMS validation guarantees E[X32^2]<=1 and hence Var(X32)<=1. For the conceptual ideal AWGN channel, Var(Y*)<=a32^2+sigma32^2 and Gaussian maximal entropy gives I(X32;Y*)<=0.5*log2(1+a32^2/sigma32^2)=2.149999824926515<=2.15<=the emitted 2.1500040690104165 bpw role payload. Q32 and the deterministic SILWARP decoder are data processing and cannot increase information.
information_channel.evaluation_law: Evaluation is reproducible Monte Carlo for the mathematical ideal AWGN law: generate Box-Muller Z in FP64, form Y* in FP64, then cast once to FP32. The finite deterministic PRF sample is an estimator, not itself the mutual-information proof.
information_channel.training_law: Training-only noise uses explicit counter-derived FP32 Box-Muller samples; it carries no proof claim.
decoder_inputs: serialized FP16 whole-matrix mean and RMS

architecture.name: SILWARP
architecture.identity: exact residual-zero initialization and one bypass bit per role in the charged expert header
architecture.serialization: little-endian IEEE binary16 in parameter_order after a closed 4096-byte header; every promotion score reloads the exact serialized bytes

controls.construction: two independent domain-separated counter/Box-Muller Monte Carlo Gaussian matrices; each uses the interior midpoint of its Qwen partner's serialized FP16 RMS cell, then passes the identical post-cast moment algorithm, preserving the exact charged FP16 mean/RMS while guaranteeing unit-moment legality even when Qwen required an extra safety ULP
controls.cluster_se: maximum delete-one jackknife SE over whole layers, whole experts, and complete layer-expert pairs

optimization.loss: raw-domain SSE-aligned weighted MSE: each uniformly sampled tile receives decoder-visible serialized_rms^2, with normalization by values_per_tile*sum(weights); Qwen and both controls share identical weights
optimization.training_seed_policy: both fixed seeds run; never select the better seed

checkpoint_resume.state: all six FP32 model states, Adam first/second moments and step, history, predecessor seal, source/code/sentinel bindings, and exact runtime identity
checkpoint_resume.counter_randomness: one batch-index vector derives from training seed and absolute update and is shared exactly by Qwen/null_a/null_b; channel noise additionally includes corpus; explicit SplitMix64 counters and Box-Muller use no opaque RNG state
checkpoint_resume.runtime_identity: Python, NumPy, CuPy, CUDA runtime and driver, device id/name/UUID, and compute capability; resume rejects any mismatch
checkpoint_resume.resume_policy: load and validate the complete append-only predecessor chain; reject incomplete, overwritten, nonfinite, hash-inconsistent, code/source/sentinel-inconsistent, or runtime-inconsistent state

stopping.update_512_hard_kill: for both fixed training seeds: U512<0.10 and U512-U256<0.012
stopping.calibration_promotion: FP16-reloaded primary F<=0.8; primary worst-null s_match-2SE>=0.1673974074587855; every layer and layer-expert Qwen aggregate positive; sensitivity seed point F<=0.8 and worst-null s_match>0
stopping.confirmation: opened only after calibration promotion; no retraining or model selection

gpu_source_free_preflight_required: one warmup plus three timed production-spec batch-512 forward/backward/Adam steps with all six model/Adam cells resident; receipt binds code/source/runtime and reports timing and memory-pool peaks
